sections.heading: Ekta Kapoor — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ekta Kapoor was born on 7 June 1975 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Jeetendra and her mother, Shobha Kapoor. She is a sibling of Tusshar Kapoor.
She studied at Mithibai College and Bombay Scottish School.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi and English.
